title: The Role-Fit Test: Why Good Players Can Be Wrong Signings for Punjab Kings
dek: A good player is not always a good signing. Batters who scored more slowly for Punjab Kings than for other teams show how often role and fit change output.
excerpt: Of the batters who have played substantially for Punjab Kings and for other sides, some scored notably slower for PBKS, and some notably faster. Fit, not only ability, decided which.
author: CricField Editorial Desk
keyTakeaways: {{ev:rf-both}} batters have at least one hundred and fifty balls both for PBKS and for other teams.
{{ev:rf-drops-n}} of them scored at least ten points slower relative to the season average for PBKS; {{ev:rf-lifts}} scored at least ten points faster.
Relative strike rate elsewhere and for PBKS correlate at {{ev:rf-r}}.

sections.heading: Ability Is Not Fit
body: A batter's output depends on role: batting position, the phase he enters, the partners around him and the instructions he is given. A strong player in the wrong role can look ordinary.
CricField compared every batter with at least one hundred and fifty balls both for Punjab Kings and for other teams, using strike rate relative to the season average so that eras compare fairly.

sections.heading: Who Changed
body: Of {{ev:rf-both}} such batters, {{ev:rf-drops-n}} scored at least ten points slower relative to the season average for PBKS, and {{ev:rf-lifts}} scored at least ten points faster.
The chart lists the largest drops. Their output elsewhere was a poor guide to what they gave PBKS.

sections.heading: How Predictive Is Past Output?
body: Relative strike rate elsewhere and for PBKS correlate at {{ev:rf-r}}. Past output carries information, but role and context account for much of the rest.

sections.heading: Caveats
body: Players move between teams at different stages of their careers, so some drops are ageing rather than fit. Strike rate also ignores dismissals.
The comparison is a screening tool, not a verdict on any player.

sections.heading: CricField Verdict: Sign for the Role
body: Punjab Kings should sign batters for a defined role and check whether their past output came in a similar one.
A player's record in the same batting position and phase is a better guide than his overall numbers.
